title: QA Pilot Risk-Based Review Depth Evaluation
description: Schema for a risk-based review depth evaluation. Consumes 9 risk inputs and produces an advisory review depth assignment (none/light/standard/heavy) with escalation chain traceability. Does not auto-accept, auto-reject, execute, approve, seal, verify, close, mutate, or replace Owner decision authority. Owner remains the final decision point.

authority_change.description: Whether the result involves authority boundary changes

production_path_impact.description: Whether the result affects production code or data paths

ledger_registry_change.description: Whether the result modifies ledger, index, or registry records

cross_node_involvement.description: Whether the result spans multiple agent nodes

partial_completion.description: Whether the result has partial completion status

rc_failure_count.description: Number of failed RC consistency checks

e4_failure_count.description: Number of failed E4 evidence checks

lightweight_lane.description: Whether this result is in a lightweight lane

composite_risk_score.description: Composite risk score derived from weighted risk inputs before escalation

assigned_depth.description: Final review depth after base score + escalation rules

escalation_chain.description: List of escalation rule IDs that fired (ER-1 through ER-10)

authority_disclaimer.const: This risk-based review depth evaluation is advisory-only. It does not auto-accept evidence, auto-reject findings, execute work, approve intake, verify evidence, close workbench items, seal anything, mutate the evidence chain, or replace Owner decision authority. Owner remains the final decision point. Custody is qa-pilot-local. Librarian impact is none.
